# #27 Rollup — marketing warehouse + safe text-to-SQL

Status: **kickoff** (2026-11-13). Repo: `shanelabountyai/rollup` (public). Port 8000.
Base: standalone Python (dbt-core + DuckDB) with a small Next.js query UI, or a FastAPI + HTMX UI (D-03).

**Why:** marketing-ops hiring managers live in attribution, pipeline and spend questions. Rollup shows the full
path: messy source tables → modeled warehouse → a natural-language question answered with SQL that is shown,
checked and safe.

**Data (synthetic, generated by a seeded script):** 18 months for a fictional B2B company: ad platform spend by
day/campaign (3 platforms), web sessions with UTMs, form fills, CRM contacts/leads/opportunities with stage history,
closed revenue, and a deliberately messy layer (UTM casing drift, duplicate leads, a timezone mismatch, a renamed
campaign) so the modeling has real work to do.

**Warehouse:** dbt project on DuckDB — `staging` (clean, typed), `intermediate` (identity-stitched leads,
campaign mapping table), `marts` (`fct_spend`, `fct_pipeline`, `fct_touches`, `dim_campaign`, `dim_channel`,
`mart_funnel_weekly`, `mart_cac_by_channel`). dbt tests on every model (unique, not null, relationships, accepted
values) plus custom tests for the injected defects. Docs generated with `dbt docs`.

**Text-to-SQL:** question → LLM drafts SQL against the **marts only** (schema + column descriptions from dbt
manifest as context) → guards → show SQL → run → table + chart + one-paragraph answer that cites the numbers in
the result.

Guards (all in code, not prompt): parse with sqlglot; single `SELECT` only; allowlisted schemas/tables; no
`*` on fact tables; row limit injected; read-only DuckDB connection; 5-second timeout; the answer paragraph may
only use numbers present in the result set (validator). Refusal path for questions the marts can't answer.

**Eval:** 40 golden questions with hand-written reference SQL; score = result-set equivalence (not SQL text match).
Yardstick (#26) consumes the run file.

**Out of scope:** real ad platform APIs, multi-touch attribution models beyond first/last/linear, write access.

**Invariants:** RU-01 no non-SELECT statement ever executes; RU-02 no table outside the allowlist is read;
RU-03 every number in an answer paragraph appears in its result set; RU-04 data generation is seeded and
reproducible; RU-05 dbt tests all pass on the generated data.

**Phases:** 1 generator + dbt models + tests (no LLM) → 2 guards + SQL runner with hand-written SQL → 3 LLM
drafting + answer validator + golden-set eval → 4 UI + charts + README case study.
